data.name: PageTitle
data.comment: Title of the Money page in the browser tab.

data.name: Title
data.comment: Heading of the page that adds up what was spent on plants and supplies, and what was brought in.

data.name: Intro
data.value: Only what has a price is counted.
data.comment: Line under the totals. Prices are plain numbers with no currency.

data.name: Empty
data.value: Nothing has a price yet. Prices typed on plants, orders and supplies are added up here.
data.comment: Shown when no plant, order or supply has a price.

data.name: Spent
data.comment: Total of everything bought in a year.

data.name: BroughtIn
data.comment: Total of plants and cuttings that were sold in a year.

data.name: PartPlants
data.comment: Part of what was spent: plants and cuttings bought.

data.name: PartShipping
data.comment: Part of what was spent: shipping on orders.

data.name: PartSupplies
data.comment: Part of what was spent: pots, soil, feeds and other supplies bought for the stock.

data.name: PartOther
data.comment: Part of what was spent: pots and loose lines ticked off the shopping list.

data.name: OrderFallback
data.comment: Name of an order line with no seller.

data.name: SuppliesRow
data.comment: Row on the Supplies page that opens the Money page.

data.name: SuppliesRowDetail
data.value: What the hobby costs, per year
data.comment: Line under Money on the Supplies page.

data.name: OrdersLink
data.comment: Link on the Orders page to the Money page.
